entries.name: Circle
entries.summary: Commercial community platform for hosting branded member spaces with built-in checkout for one-time purchases, memberships and recurring subscriptions.

leaf_matches.reason: Official Circle homepage presents a branded community venue with discussions, events and courses, plus built-in payments supporting one-time purchases, memberships or recurring subscriptions and access groups.

entries.name: Ko-fi
entries.summary: Commercial creator support platform where fans pay creators through tips or recurring memberships, with creator-set tiers and exclusive member content.

leaf_matches.reason: Official Ko-fi homepage and features page state that creators can launch memberships with tiers and exclusive content, while fans support the same creator through recurring payments made directly to that creator.

entries.name: Familiar
entries.summary: Commercial publishing and royalty management platform that keeps book/edition catalog records, attaches authors and other contributors with royalty shares, manages publishing contracts, and runs distributor statement imports through contributor statements and payments.

leaf_matches.reason: Official Familiar homepage and royalty/contract product pages show a complete author-management spine: book records with ISBNs and formats plus contributors with roles and royalty percentages; contract templates with per-format rates, advances, reserves, signers and agents that flow into royalty tracking; distributor statement imports matched to books; per-contributor calculations, advances and splits, statements, and a contributor/agent portal. The readable body is present deeper in the archived homepage HTML, not only in its head/shell.
